title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Eligibility, Run-Out and COBRA Timeframes
content:
Sponsor services schedule of the eligibility and continuation timeframes set for each Pharmacy Benefit Plan design.

| Plan design | Retroactive termination limit (calendar days) | Claims run-out (calendar days after coverage end) | COBRA maximum continuation (months) | COBRA election window (calendar days) | COBRA premium grace (calendar days) | Dependent child age limit (years) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | 60 | 90 | 18 | 60 | 30 | 26 |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | 60 | 90 | 18 | 60 | 30 | 26 |
| Northbridge Rx Value | 60 | 90 | 18 | 60 | 30 | 26 |
| Northbridge Rx Select | 60 | 180 | 18 | 60 | 30 | 26 |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | 60 | 180 | 18 | 60 | 30 | 26 |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | 60 | 180 | 18 | 60 | 30 | 26 |

## Definitions

- **Retroactive termination limit** — the maximum number of calendar days a sponsor eligibility termination may be dated back before the date the termination record is received.
- **Claims run-out** — the number of calendar days after the coverage end date during which reimbursement requests for dates of service while covered are still accepted.
- **COBRA maximum continuation** — the maximum COBRA continuation period, in months, for a termination of employment or a reduction of hours.
- **COBRA election window** — the number of calendar days from the later of the coverage end date and the COBRA election notice date within which a COBRA election reinstates coverage.
- **COBRA premium grace** — the number of calendar days after a COBRA premium due date during which the premium may be paid before coverage terminates.
- **Dependent child age limit** — the age at which a child dependent's coverage ends; coverage runs through the end of the month of that birthday.

## Reading the schedule

Only the claims run-out differs across the lineup: 90 days on Northbridge Rx HSA Saver, Basic and Value, and 180 days on Northbridge Rx Select, Plus and Premier. Every other timeframe is the same on all six designs.

### Illustration (hypothetical dependent)

A hypothetical child dependent turns 26 on 14 August. Coverage runs through the end of that month, so the last day of the child's coverage is 31 August.
